title: Chapter 12 City Expansion
content:
Chapter 12 City Expansion

"Senior Ji, what did your son just say about the expansion?"

At this time, someone asked Ji Wuhui above.

After hearing this, Ji Wuhui turned his head and looked at his son, and then said in a calm voice: "Shengcai means what I mean."

Hearing this, everyone suddenly breathed a little faster.

They could imagine that after a period of time, there would definitely be earth-shaking changes here.

You know, this is the Ji family.

If it was just Master Ji before, in fact, the real high-level strongmen among them would not take it seriously.

After all, although Ji Shengcai has a noble status in the Ji family, he is still not the real boss of the Ji family.

And now, Ji Wuhui has spoken.

That's completely different.

"Master Ji, although your Ji family is big and powerful, I think you will also encounter some troubles in expanding the city. I am willing to join the alliance on Tianyin Island."

Just when everyone was thinking about it, Mu Tianyin suddenly spoke.

All of a sudden, everyone looked at Mu Tianyin.

Mu Tianyin smiled and looked at Ji Wuhui in the sky quietly.

What is this senior Tianyin doing? No matter how strong Tianyin Island is, can it be compared with the Ji family?

Although Mu Tianyin and Ji Wuhui are both in the realm of life union, the influence of the Ji family almost covers the entire Tianxuan world.

And Tianyin Island is only famous in a certain area.

If you want to join the alliance, you must be a force of at least the strength of the Ji family.

I thought Mu Tianyin would be rejected, but what everyone didn't expect was that Ji Wuhui actually nodded.

"Okay, you can discuss this matter with my son."

Hearing this, Mu Tianyin's smile became even wider.

"Thank you, Master Ji."

Agree now? ?

What's going on? !

Beside Ji Wuhui, Ji Shengcai also looked at his father with a confused look on his face.

"Dad, why?"

The Ji family is one of the most powerful forces in the entire Tianxuan world. No matter how powerful Tianyin Island is, it is just a slightly stronger local force. How can it cooperate with the family?

Who doesn't know how much money this matter has now?

Didn't you see that Chen Gui was willing to offend the Ji family to get a house?

But now, this piece of money is so easy to cooperate with Tianyin Island.

"Shengcai, the identity of that girl is not simple. You just need to remember not to have too much conflict with her. Of course, but don't deliberately give in to her."

"Emm, if you can, you can try to capture her."

"Ah?!"

Hearing his father's words, Ji Shengcai was shocked.

The feather fan in his hand had already fallen to the ground.

Unexpectedly, the owner of Tianyin Island, Mu Tianyin, had such a frightening background.

Even his father had to give face.

The key is that his father actually asked him to capture Mu Tianyin.

Then, Ji Shengcai turned his head to look at Mu Tianyin in the distance.

After looking at her for a while, Ji Shengcai was silent.

She was indeed good-looking, but she seemed a little older than himself.

But the older she was, the better she tasted.

Wait, what was he thinking about? Why did he want to capture her?

At this time, as if he felt Ji Shengcai's gaze, Mu Tianyin immediately turned his head to look at him. For a moment, the two of them looked at each other and sparks flew.

"Ahem."

Ji Shengcai coughed twice and turned his head away quickly to hide his embarrassment, but his handsome face couldn't help but blush slightly.

"Haha, Shengcai, how is it?"

Seeing Ji Shengcai like this, Ji Wuhui raised his eyebrows slightly and said with some joy.

Hearing this, Ji Shengcai adjusted his mood and said quickly: "Dad, I still want to focus on my career now, so don't mention this matter." Seeing this, Ji Wuhui showed a meaningful smile, then patted Ji Shengcai on the shoulder, and said nothing more. In the distance, Mu Tianyin frowned slightly. Was the stinky boy of the Ji family just looking at him? Did he still hate him? Isn't it just some real estate? As for? If this aunt wants, it is not impossible to take the whole Huangzhou into her pocket. After a while, the scene was quiet for a while, and suddenly several bold and rich masters came forward to ask. "Mr. Ji, can I pre-order some of the real estate here after it is built?" "Mr. Ji, I also want to pre-order." "I want to, Mr. Ji, and me!" Suddenly, several people came forward one after another, as if they were afraid that they would not be able to grab it. When everyone saw this, they were anxious. At this moment, they only regretted that they didn't have enough money. After a moment's hesitation, the rich rushed forward, and the poor hurried home to get money.

"Everyone, this property can indeed be pre-ordered, but the pre-order price may be a little expensive."

Seeing everyone doing this, Ji Shengcai was immediately overjoyed and spoke quickly.

"Mr. Ji, you are being polite. We can still afford the money to buy a property."

"Yes, yes, yes, Mr. Ji, don't keep us in suspense."

"Okay, in that case, then I will just say it directly. The price is one million spirit stones per set."

Puff~

Suddenly, everyone was dumbfounded.

"This, this, this, Mr. Ji, isn't this too high?"

One million per set, they were originally planning to buy ten sets first.

Unexpectedly, with this one million per set, each of them could only buy two sets at most.

However, Ji Shengcai just smiled faintly at the people in front of him.

"Haha, not expensive, not expensive at all. You should know that the city real estate built by my Ji family is absolutely worth every penny. It is fair and honest."

Hearing this, everyone was silent.

But someone still said: "One million per set is too expensive. Master Ji, if you don't lower the price a little, then I will give up."

Advance by retreat.

This person is very smart, but unfortunately, he still underestimated the future heir of the Ji family.

"It is impossible to lower the price. If you don't want to buy it, then I can only express my regret."

If you don't buy it, there are many people who buy it, and you are not a big deal.

"You,"

Suddenly, the man was a little speechless and didn't know what to say for a while.

"Master Ji, reserve two sets for me first."

Then, a storage ring was handed to Ji Shengcai.

Ji Shengcai took a look and immediately showed a satisfied smile.

Some people recognized that it was a big family in Qingzhou, and its family assets were not lower than some big forces.

As one person pre-ordered, the others could no longer hold back and came forward one after another.

"Haha, don't be impatient, it's just the beginning now, everyone has a share."

In the distance, seeing this scene, the man who had retreated before looked a little ugly. After a moment of hesitation, he still brought his belongings and went forward to pre-order.

In this way, the Ji family took over the expansion of the mysterious giant city.

Soon, the Ji family started construction.

Countless cultivators opened mountains and built cities, and one after another of the best spiritual veins were transported from other states.

In just a few days, the spiritual energy near this deserted city became rich.

This shows that the strength of the Ji family is indeed extraordinary.

"Ji family, my Tianxian Sect will also join in the expansion of the city."

"My Yueshen Sect will also join."

"And my Zhan Sect will also join."

Seeing that the expansion of the city was getting bigger and bigger, several forces came to join.

And these forces are undoubtedly all able to stand shoulder to shoulder with the Ji family and have a prominent position in the entire Tianxuan world.

After thinking about it, the Ji family agreed.

If they didn't agree, they would probably attack them.

After all, the Ji family never thought that they could take over the entire city expansion alone.

With the participation of these forces, the city expansion would be much easier.
